method: Whole-sheet 8-connected alpha components locate bodies; transparent-seam extraction retains all crop pixels. One profile scale for the entire sheet; only per-frame translation using the corresponding source lower-7.5% alpha-weighted foot centroid and bottom. No shield drawing, pixel erasure, or per-frame/action fitting.

heightDiagnostic.note: Alpha silhouette height includes weapons and pose changes; this is a review diagnostic, not a measured anatomical torso height.

cleanup.method: Remove only entire 8-connected nonzero-alpha components whose every pixel has alpha exactly 1. Any component with alpha above 1 is preserved in full, including all connected antialiasing and weapon pixels. The strict all-alpha edge gate is unchanged.

backgroundBranches.reason: Reviewed alpha-1 background branches reach frame boundaries. Preserve all alpha>=2 pixels and every alpha-1 pixel within two Chebyshev pixels of them; remove only alpha-1 background at distance at least three.
